lore: At the edge of the city stands a tower that never sleeps. It was raised on the owner's words, 'we need a memalloc watch tower', and from its top a keeper looks over the Lake. Thirty-eight times the Lake has looked empty from the tower. Twenty-nine of those times the keeper walked down to the shore and called the newest thing by name, and every time it answered. Nothing was lost; only the count of it was. The keeper writes every change in a chain that cannot be rewritten, and keeps one more rule: if the tower itself goes quiet for twelve minutes, the alarm sounds, because silence is not the same as safety. The ledger has no entry for a dog. That is how the keeper knows she was there.
